what: Several photo strips are joined horizontally, and the hovered (pressed, focused) strip spreads to 6 times the width of the others by spring (stiffness 160 · damping 20). The borders between strips bow like a bow by the speed moved (speed×1.6, stiffness 300 · damping 40) and then straighten, and the image near a bowed border (within 90px) is dragged along (.6). Closed strips are 15% darker and the opened strip’s name line rises .15s later from .5em below. The strips are drawn with a single WebGL shader. On phones (767px and under) the strips stack vertically without the shader

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cells (multiple, max 8, required) — a horizontal (or vertical) flex row inside the plate
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Cell image (img) — if absent, draws a clothing-color placeholder image from the cell’s data-label
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Name line shown only on the open cell (optional)
options.open: How many times larger the open cell is than closed ones, default 6
options.drag: How strongly the curved edge pulls the image, default .6
options.--fx-ph-from · --fx-ph-to · --fx-ph-line: Two gradient colors, diagonal and text of the placeholder when there is no image (set per cell with CSS variables), default --kf-raised · --kf-dim · --kf-line · --kf-ink

note: If the row of cells inside the plate is flex-direction: column, it bends vertically. The plate corner radius reads the first cell’s border-radius. Images must be same-origin (or CORS-allowed) to become textures
